messages:
ajay: FYI — AcmeCorp reporting spikes of API 5xx / 504 gateway timeouts from hosted inference in eu-west starting ~10:12Z. High volume, multiple customers. Ticket #INC-9812. @kim @ethan can you triage?

support-bot: Escalation created: INC-9812. First error samples attached by customer.

nora: Customer says errors correlate with bursts after scheduled batch jobs. They see initial failures then things slowly recover after ~5-7m. They’re seeing billing for failed requests. Not happy.

kim: grabbing logs now. any recent rollout?

ethan: No infra deploys in last 24h. We did push a small readiness-probe tweak to model-server images 36h ago (lowered initialDelaySeconds from 30 -> 5). Might be related but odd.

ops-bot: keda: scaler events: [scale loop start], activationThreshold=100, currentValue=98 -> no scale, then spike to 1200 -> scaleUpTriggered. HPA: desiredReplicas 0->20, podsCreating 0->20.

ajay: that pattern smells like thundering herd: KEDA waits for activation, then a big spike triggers scaling but pods are slow to become Ready. gateway hits them and returns 504s.

kim: getting gateway logs. snippet: 
```
2026-03-15T10:12:34Z gateway INFO request_id=abc123 upstream_timeout after 30s -> 504
2026-03-15T10:12:36Z gateway INFO request_id=def456 upstream_error code=502 connection_reset
```

ethan: model-server pod logs during startup: 
```
[init] pulling model weights... ETA 2m 30s
[init] loading quantized kernels... heavy cpu for first batch
[readiness] probe failing: HTTP 500 - model not initialized
```

nora: so readiness probe returns failure for a long time, KEDA sees pods in Creating state and traffic keeps hitting gateway -> 504. Customer wants an ETA and refund for failed calls.

kim: repro plan: simulate a 10k QPS burst with current autoscale config (KEDA with activation 100, cooldown 30s, minReplicaCount 0). See if scale-up lag > 30s and causes 504s.

ajay: do it in a canary namespace first. Also instrument readiness time distribution and coldstart durations.

ethan: running load test now (script: `wrk -t12 -c1000 -d120s http://canary-host/serve`). Initial run shows first successful request after first pod Ready ~1m40s. Median ready time 95s.

kim: that matches model init logs. So root cause: long coldstart / model initialization time + KEDA/HPA config that allows min replicas 0 and long activation thresholds. KEDA reacts but pods not Ready quickly.

nora: immediate mitigation for customer?

ajay: short-term: increase minReplicaCount to 3 for their tenant in eu-west and set targetReplicaCount to a safe floor. Also set KEDA activationThreshold lower so it scales earlier for gradual growth? Wait — lowering activationThreshold can cause flapping. Alternative: set minReplicaCount>0.

kim: Agree: set minReplicaCount:3 and scaleUpCooldown: 120s, set maxReplicaCount to 50. Also add a warmup job: a small cron that hits the model once/hour to keep at least one warmed instance (not ideal but quick).

ethan: I'll patch readiness probe to be slightly more conservative (initialDelay 60s -> 30s?) — careful: we previously lowered it to speed things up, but that made gateway route traffic to not-ready pods. We should increase initialDelay and ensure readiness checks reflect model init state (e.g., `GET /health?full=true` that requires weights loaded).

kim: also adding prefetch to local disk for model weights and enabling lazy load on first request might require code changes; not in scope for immediate fix.

support-bot: Customer notified: we’re opening a mitigation plan: temporary reserved warm capacity + billing review. Will provide ETA in 30m.

nora: thanks. Can we also add a routing fallback to a smaller model variant when autoscale is still catching up? Means less quality but prevents timeouts.

ajay: good idea. Add routing rule in gateway to call model-variant-lite after X retries or after 20s upstream wait. Implement as A/B failover.

kim: action items: 
- kim: change KEDA minReplicaCount to 3 for AcmeCorp tenant (eu-west) and set scaleUpCooldown 120s.
- ethan: revert readiness probe tweak and implement a `full` readiness check that returns 200 only after model weights loaded.
- nora: communicate to AcmeCorp and request window for reserved capacity.
- ajay: create rollback playbook in case this change causes cost spike.

ethan: making PR for readiness probe now. sample change: 
```yaml
readinessProbe:
  httpGet:
    path: /health?full=true
    port: 8080
  initialDelaySeconds: 60
  periodSeconds: 10
  failureThreshold: 6
```

kim: patching KEDA scaler: set `minReplicaCount: 3` and `pollingIntervalSeconds: 10` for faster reaction. Also added `cooldownPeriod` 120.

ops-bot: applying change to namespace acmecorp-eu-west: keda scaler update OK, HPA updated, rolling restart scheduled to pick up readiness change.

ajay: monitor metrics: gateway 504 rate, pod Ready latency, KEDA events. Dashboards: `infra/autoscale/latency`, `infra/gateway/5xx-rate`.

ethan: initial verification after changes: first coldstart after KEDA change served in ~40s (warmed image from previous keepalive), 504s dropped from 18/min -> 1/min.

nora: customer update sent: "We’ve applied temporary warm capacity and probe fixes. We’re continuing to monitor and will refund failed calls; support will follow up."

kim: follow-ups (not blocking): explore image optimization, model weight sharding, and reserved dedicated capacity offerings for heavy bursty customers. Also consider pre-warm hooks in KEDA operator.

ajay: closing the incident when 24h stable with <1% error for that tenant. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
